map.本工具用于检测（成分/性能/质量）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (composition / performance / quality) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：材料三项检测判定（主成分/性能/质量评分）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Material Test (Main Component / Performance / Quality Score)
map.材料进场自检：按主成分含量、性能合格率、质量综合评分三项判定: Material incoming self-check: judge by three items — main component content, performance pass rate, overall quality score
map.质量分级：综合评分反映整体合格水平: Quality grading: the overall score reflects the general qualification level
map.逐项判定：主成分含量≥95%、性能指标合格率≥95%、质量综合评分≥85 分；三: Item-by-item: main component content ≥ 95%, performance pass rate ≥ 95%, overall quality score ≥ 85; all three satisfied = pass. The score integrates multiple metrics; below 85 suggests overall weakness.
map.主成分 96%（≥95 ✓）、性能合格率 97%（≥95 ✓）、质量评分 88: Main component 96% (≥95 ✓), performance pass rate 97% (≥95 ✓), quality score 88 (≥85 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If score drops to 82 it fails, overall quality unmet.
map.质量综合评分怎么来？: How is the overall quality score derived?
map.为厂内多项检测加权得出的内部评分（非强制标准），≥85 为合格线；正式验收须以各: It is an internal score from weighted in-plant tests (not a mandatory standard); ≥85 is the pass line. Formal acceptance must rely on individual test reports.
map.主成分够为啥还要性能合格率？: If main component is sufficient, why also require performance pass rate?
map.主成分对不代表制成后性能达标（如分散、晶型影响），性能合格率独立考核实际使用表现: High main component does not guarantee post-processing performance (e.g., dispersion, crystal form affect it); the performance pass rate independently assesses actual use behavior.
map.成分分析需使用标准方法，如光谱、色谱、质谱: Composition analysis requires standard methods such as spectroscopy, chromatography, mass spectrometry
map.质量评分综合多项指标，需全面评估: The quality score integrates multiple indicators and requires comprehensive assessment
